newsitem.title: HUNGARY: PRESIDENT OF HUNGARY JUNIOR COALITION MEMBER QUITS.
newsitem.headline: PRESIDENT OF HUNGARY JUNIOR COALITION MEMBER QUITS.

text.p: President of Hungary's junior coalition partner, the Alliance of Free Democrats (SZDSZ) Ivan Peto, resigned on Monday, Hungarian news agency MTI said, referring to several unnamed sources.
MTI said Peto also quit the post of SZDSZ parliamentary faction leader.
Peto announced his resignation at the extraordinary meeting of the party's presidential board, MTI said.
According to unconfirmed reports Interior Minister Gabor Kuncze was appointed as the temporary leader of the SZDSZ.
The Hungarian Radio said that SZDSZ confirmed Peto's resignation and Kuncze informed Prime Minister Gyula Horn about Peto's decision to resign.
